'''Dal-Rin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Voss Mystics|Mystic]] living on [[Voss]] long before the [[Galactic War]]. After his death, he became the keeper of the [[dream-rock]] located in the [[Dark Heart]] of the [[Nightmare Lands]] and used in the [[Forbidden Ritual]]. Around [[3640 BBY]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] and a Gormak named [[Hadrik]] used the dream-rock and performed the ritual, allowing Kallig to silence the [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghosts]] inside their mind.

==Behind the scenes==
Dal-Rin appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission on Voss.
